hook: Titanium lattice floats by filling hollow beams with foam
what_happened: Researchers 3D‑printed Ti‑6Al‑4V hollow‑strut lattices and injected polyurethane foam into the channels, creating a buoyant hybrid structure
why_it_matters: It removes the density bottleneck of titanium, enabling strong, corrosion‑resistant marine components that stay afloat even after damage
the_catch: Tests were limited to a 4×4×4 lattice cube; performance under larger scales or different loading conditions is untested
caption: A titanium lattice can float when its hollow beams are filled with lightweight foam, giving it buoyancy while keeping its strength. How could this change marine engineering?
alt_text: Five slides explaining that a 3D‑printed titanium lattice can float when its hollow beams are filled with polyurethane foam, showing the design, testing, and implications

es.hook: La estructura de celosía de titanio flota al llenar vigas huecas con espuma
es.what_happened: Los investigadores imprimieron en 3D lattices de Ti‑6Al‑4V con vigas huecas e inyectaron espuma de poliuretano en los canales, creando una estructura híbrida con flotabilidad
es.why_it_matters: Elimina el cuello de botella de densidad del titanio, permitiendo componentes marinos fuertes y resistentes a la corrosión que permanecen a flote incluso tras daños
es.the_catch: Las pruebas se limitaron a un cubo de celosía 4×4×4; el rendimiento a escalas mayores o bajo diferentes condiciones de carga no ha sido evaluado
